summary: Perpetua Resources Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on June 4, 2026. Shareholders voted on four items: fixing the board at nine directors; electing nine director nominees; approving the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan (an amendment/restatement of the existing plan with no increase in share reserve); and ratifying PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer was disclosed. The filing is a routine current report on shareholder meeting outcomes and compensatory plan approval, not a special situation.
